summary: Frontend-only mobile preview testing completed for Color Tap Challenge. Core gameplay passed; settings interaction was blocked by an off-viewport modal row.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667, the Sound toggle is rendered outside the viewport and Playwright reports Element is outside of the viewport, preventing tapping the setting.

issues: Modal content does not fit or scroll within the mobile viewport; toggle rows are inaccessible.

action_items: Constrain or make the SettingsModal content scrollable so Sound and Vibration toggles are accessible at 375x667; retest toggle persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: Core screen and gameplay code is compact and uses testIDs on interactive controls. Settings modal lacks a mobile-safe scroll strategy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at 375x667. Home, game start, five correct taps to Level 2, three wrong taps to Game Over, and Play Again passed. Settings opened but its Sound toggle was outside viewport.
rca_of_issue: SettingsModal renders a bottom-aligned card with fixed padding and no ScrollView or viewport-aware sizing. On the mobile web preview, the card extends below the 667px viewport, so the Sound row cannot receive a normal tap. Best-score and settings persistence were not fully verified because the blocked settings interaction stopped that flow.
